prompt: I have a Python project with coding standards in .claude/rules/python-standards.md. I want you to add enforcement blocks to the two error handling rules: 'No bare except: clauses' and 'No type: ignore comments without an error code'. Classify them and add the blocks.

assertions.text: Both rules are classified as T1
Each enforcement block contains a regex pattern field that would match the violation
The scope field targets Python files (e.g., **/*.py or src/**/*.py)
The skill presents its recommendation and reasoning before generating blocks
The blocks are placed immediately after each rule's text
A budget check is performed after generating blocks
